column3: cma: conditionally prefer cma pageblocks for movable allocations

column1: Currently a cma area is barely used by the page allocator because it's
used only as a fallback from movable
column2: however kswapd tries hard to make

column1: sure that the fallback path isn't used.
This results in a system evicting memory and pushing data into swap
lots of CMA memory is still available.  This happens despite the fact that
alloc_contig_range is perfectly capable of moving any movable allocations
out of the way of an allocation.
To effectively use the cma area let's alter the rules: if the zone has
more free cma pages than the half of total free pages in the zone
pageblocks first and fallback to movable blocks in the case of failure.
